facts.text: The vehicle booking system provides services that are local and rental based for customers on demand.
All implementations for the vehicle booking system are in the context of MySQL.
A database schema needs to be established to support the implementation.
A logical flow of the data needs to be shown using draw.io or another suitable tool.
Tables such as Vehicle Data, Customer_Requests, and Bookings need to be prepared with suitable constraints to store records.
The data needs to be populated and the most frequently booked route in Chennai needs to be displayed.
The number of customers who travelled in each data and in each route needs to be displayed.
The bookings count greater than 50 in each day needs to be displayed.
The most booked type of vehicle (SUV, Mini, etc.) in Bangalore City needs to be listed.
The 5 star rated driver details need to be displayed to initiate incentives by the company.
Observations need to be commented to suggest betterment of customer experience.
Existing vehicle providers such as OLA and UBER need to be taken as examples to observe the database management process.
Important and possible implementations for the project need to be listed based on OLA and UBER.
More efficient database design needs to be implemented with more details.
